Shiny applications

Source: vignettes/shiny.Rmd
shiny.Rmd

Browse the Shiny gallery in a new tab, or run the examples here alongside their R source. The first launch downloads R and its dependencies. The apps use the highcharter version documented here.

Basics

Select Sepal or Petal. The same 150 flowers move to their new coordinates. Put highchartOutput("flowers") in the UI and read input$measure inside renderHighchart() to rebuild the plot when the measurement changes.

library(shiny)
library(highcharter)

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5),
  style = "max-width: 48rem;",
  selectInput("measure", "Iris measurements", c("Sepal", "Petal")),
  highchartOutput("flowers", height = "310px")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$flowers <- renderHighchart({
    hchart(
      iris,
      "scatter",
      hcaes_string(
        x = paste0(input$measure, ".Length"),
        y = paste0(input$measure, ".Width"),
        group = "Species"
      )
    ) |>
      hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "Length (cm)")) |>
      hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Width (cm)"))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

Open the app in its own tab

Proxies

Start with twelve months of air passenger counts. Add a month appends one observation with hcpxy_add_point(). Columns changes the series type with hcpxy_update_series(). Switch back to Line and your added months are still there. Both controls target the series ID traffic through highchartProxy("passengers", session).

library(shiny)
library(highcharter)

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5),
  style = "max-width: 48rem;",
  actionButton("next_month", "Add a month"),
  radioButtons(
    "type",
    "Chart type",
    c("Line" = "line", "Columns" = "column"),
    inline = TRUE
  ),
  highchartOutput("passengers", height = "300px")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  passengers <- as.numeric(AirPassengers)
  initial <- 12L
  output$passengers <- renderHighchart({
    highchart() |>
      hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "Month since January 1949")) |>
      hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Passengers (thousands)")) |>
      hc_add_series(
        type = "line",
        id = "traffic",
        name = "Air passengers",
        pointStart = 1,
        data = passengers[seq_len(initial)]
      )
  })

  proxy <- highchartProxy("passengers", session)
  observeEvent(input$next_month, {
    i <- initial + input$next_month
    req(i <= length(passengers))
    hcpxy_add_point(proxy, id = "traffic", point = passengers[i])
  })
  observeEvent(
    input$type,
    {
      hcpxy_update_series(proxy, id = "traffic", type = input$type)
    },
    ignoreInit = TRUE
  )
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

Open the app in its own tab

To switch from weekly to daily Stock prices when the visible date range narrows, run the Stock proxy app or read the Stock walkthrough.

Events

Each lit segment adds 1 dB to the band’s gain, starting at −12 dB. Hover over a band, click it, then drag its top and release it. Each event has its own readout. The drag and mouseOver values refresh at most once every 150 ms. The drop value shows the final gain as soon as you release the band.

library(shiny)
library(highcharter)

bands <- data.frame(
  band = c("60 Hz", "250 Hz", "1 kHz", "4 kHz", "16 kHz"),
  gain = c(0, 5, -4, 8, 2)
)
events <- c("click", "drag", "mouseOver", "drop")

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5),
  style = "max-width: 48rem;",
  tags$head(tags$style(
    "
    #eq .highcharts-grid-line { pointer-events: none; }
    #readings { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    #readings .recalculating { opacity: 1; }
  "
  )),
  tags$main(
    h2("Equalizer"),
    p("Hover or click a band. Drag its top to change the gain."),
    highchartOutput("eq", height = "320px"),
    h3("Latest event by type"),
    tags$dl(
      id = "readings",
      class = "row row-cols-2 row-cols-sm-4",
      lapply(events, function(event) {
        div(
          class = "col",
          tags$dt(event),
          tags$dd(textOutput(event, inline = TRUE))
        )
      })
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$eq <- renderHighchart({
    hchart(
      bands,
      "column",
      hcaes(x = band, y = gain, id = band),
      name = "Gain",
      color = "#39d9f5",
      zIndex = 1,
      cursor = "ns-resize",
      dragDrop = list(
        draggableY = TRUE,
        dragMinY = -12,
        dragMaxY = 12,
        dragPrecisionY = 1
      )
    ) |>
      hc_add_series(
        type = "column",
        name = "Band range",
        data = rep(12, nrow(bands)),
        color = "#203245",
        enableMouseTracking = FALSE,
        accessibility = list(enabled = FALSE),
        zIndex = 0
      ) |>
      hc_plotOptions(
        column = list(
          grouping = FALSE,
          threshold = -12,
          borderWidth = 0,
          borderRadius = 0,
          maxPointWidth = 54,
          minPointLength = 4
        )
      ) |>
      hc_chart(backgroundColor = "#101a29") |>
      hc_legend(enabled = FALSE) |>
      hc_xAxis(
        title = list(text = NULL),
        gridLineWidth = 0,
        labels = list(style = list(color = "#e4ecf4"))
      ) |>
      hc_yAxis(
        min = -12,
        max = 12,
        tickInterval = 1,
        labels = list(step = 6, style = list(color = "#e4ecf4")),
        title = list(text = "Gain (dB)", style = list(color = "#e4ecf4")),
        gridLineColor = "#101a29",
        gridLineWidth = 2,
        gridZIndex = 4
      ) |>
      hc_tooltip(valueSuffix = " dB", valueDecimals = 0) |>
      hc_add_event_point(event = "mouseOver") |>
      hc_add_event_point(event = "drag") |>
      hc_add_event_point(event = "drop")
  })

  lapply(events, function(event) {
    point <- reactive(input[[paste0("eq_point_", event)]])
    reading <- if (event %in% c("drag", "mouseOver")) {
      throttle(point, 150)
    } else {
      point
    }
    output[[event]] <- renderText({
      value <- reading()
      if (is.null(value)) {
        return("—")
      }
      sprintf("%s · %+d dB", value$pointid, as.integer(value$y))
    })
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

Open the app in its own tab

Point clicks arrive automatically at input$eq_point_click. Register mouseOver, drag and drop with hc_add_event_point() to receive their inputs too. For example, input$eq_point_mouseOver$pointid identifies the band under the pointer and input$eq_point_drag$y gives its gain during a drag.

Linked views

The dotplot shows mean petal length by species, rounded to the nearest millimeter. With colorByPoint = TRUE, each species gets its own color. Pause over a species for 200 ms or click it for an immediate selection. The detail shows petal length and width for its 50 flowers in the same color. A Shiny proxy updates the detail points, series color and title while keeping the axes fixed for comparison.

library(shiny)
library(highcharter)

species <- aggregate(Petal.Length ~ Species, iris, mean)
species$mean_mm <- round(10 * species$Petal.Length)
colors <- setNames(
  hc_theme("hcrt")$colors[seq_len(nrow(species))],
  species$Species
)

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5),
  style = "max-width: 60rem;",
  tags$main(
    p(
      "Each dot represents 1 mm of mean petal length.",
      "Hover or click a species to see its 50 flowers in the same color."
    ),
    fluidRow(
      column(
        5,
        div(
          class = "mx-auto",
          style = "max-width: 24rem;",
          highchartOutput("overview", height = "295px")
        )
      ),
      column(7, highchartOutput("detail", height = "295px"))
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$overview <- renderHighchart({
    hchart(
      species,
      "dotplot",
      hcaes(x = Species, y = mean_mm, id = Species),
      name = "Mean petal length",
      colorByPoint = TRUE,
      slotsPerBar = 3,
      itemPadding = 0.1,
      cursor = "pointer"
    ) |>
      hc_chart(inverted = TRUE) |>
      hc_colors(unname(colors)) |>
      hc_xAxis(title = list(text = NULL)) |>
      hc_yAxis(min = 0, title = list(text = "Mean petal length (mm)")) |>
      hc_tooltip(valueDecimals = 0, valueSuffix = " mm") |>
      hc_add_event_point(event = "mouseOver")
  })

  initial <- as.character(species$Species[1])
  requested <- reactiveVal(initial)
  selected <- reactiveVal(initial)
  settled <- debounce(requested, 200)
  observeEvent(settled(), selected(settled()), ignoreInit = TRUE)
  observeEvent(
    input$overview_point_mouseOver,
    requested(input$overview_point_mouseOver$pointid)
  )
  observeEvent(input$overview_point_click, {
    group <- input$overview_point_click$pointid
    requested(group)
    selected(group)
  })

  output$detail <- renderHighchart({
    hchart(
      subset(iris, Species == initial),
      "scatter",
      hcaes(x = Petal.Length, y = Petal.Width),
      id = "flowers",
      name = initial,
      color = colors[[initial]]
    ) |>
      hc_title(text = initial) |>
      hc_xAxis(min = 0, max = 7, title = list(text = "Petal length (cm)")) |>
      hc_yAxis(min = 0, max = 2.6, title = list(text = "Petal width (cm)"))
  })
  observeEvent(
    selected(),
    {
      group <- selected()
      highchartProxy("detail", session) |>
        hcpxy_set_data(
          "scatter",
          subset(iris, Species == group),
          hcaes(x = Petal.Length, y = Petal.Width),
          id = "flowers"
        ) |>
        hcpxy_update(
          title = list(text = group),
          series = list(list(
            id = "flowers",
            name = group,
            color = colors[[group]]
          ))
        )
    },
    ignoreInit = TRUE
  )
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

pkgload::load_all()
